MeasureTheory.exists_hasStrongType_real_.statement:
(Marcinkiewicz real interpolation theorem, per the docstring.) Let $\alpha$ and $\alpha'$ be measurable spaces with measures $\mu$ on $\alpha$ and $
u$ on $\alpha'$, let $E_1$ be a topological space carrying an extended-seminormed additive monoid structure ($\mathrm{ESeminormedAddMonoid}$), and let $E_2$ be a topological space with a continuous extended norm ($\mathrm{ContinuousENorm}$). Let $T$ map functions $\alpha 	o E_1$ to functions $\alpha' 	o E_2$. Let $p_0,p_1,q_0,q_1,p,q,t \in [0,\infty]$ and nonnegative reals $C_0, C_1, A$ satisfy $p_0 \in (0, q_0]$, $p_1 \in (0, q_1]$, $q_0 
e q_1$, $A \ge 1$, $t \in (0,1)$, $C_0 > 0$, $C_1 > 0$, $p^{-1} = (1-t)/p_0 + t/p_1$ and $q^{-1} = (1-t)/q_0 + t/q_1$. Suppose that $T f$ is $
u$-a.e. strongly measurable for every $f \in L^p(\mu)$, that $T$ is a.e. subadditive with constant $A$ (with respect to $
u$) on the functions $f$ lying in $L^{p_0}(\mu)$ or in $L^{p_1}(\mu)$, and that $T$ has weak type $(p_0, q_0)$ with constant $C_0$ and weak type $(p_1, q_1)$ with constant $C_1$ (with respect to $\mu, 
u$). Then $T$ has strong type $(p, q)$ with respect to $\mu, 
u$ with constant $C_{\mathrm{realInterpolation}}(p_0, p_1, q_0, q_1, q, C_0, C_1, A, t)$.

MeasureTheory.combine_estimates₁.statement:
Let $\alpha$ and $\alpha'$ be measurable spaces with measures $\mu$ on $\alpha$ and $
u$ on $\alpha'$, let $E_1$ be a topological space carrying an extended-seminormed additive monoid structure ($\mathrm{ESeminormedAddMonoid}$), and let $E_2$ be a topological space with a continuous extended norm ($\mathrm{ContinuousENorm}$). Let $T$ map functions $\alpha 	o E_1$ to functions $\alpha' 	o E_2$. Let $p,q,p_0,q_0,p_1,q_1,t \in [0,\infty]$, and let $A, C_0, C_1$ be nonnegative reals with $A > 0$, $C_0 > 0$, $C_1 > 0$. Assume $p_0 \in (0, q_0]$, $p_1 \in (0, q_1]$, $t \in (0,1)$, $p_0 < p_1$, $q_0 
e q_1$, $p^{-1} = (1-t)p_0^{-1} + t p_1^{-1}$ and $q^{-1} = (1-t)q_0^{-1} + t q_1^{-1}$. Let $f : \alpha 	o E_1$ with $f \in L^p(\mu)$ and $0 < \|f\|_{L^p(\mu)} < \infty$; suppose $T$ is subadditive under truncation of $f$ with constant $A$ with respect to $
u$ ($\mathrm{SubadditiveTrunc}\ T\ A\ f\ 
u$), $T$ has weak type $(p_1, q_1)$ with constant $C_1$ and weak type $(p_0, q_0)$ with constant $C_0$ (from $\mu$ to $
u$), and $T$ preserves a.e. strong measurability for $L^p$ functions (from $\mu$ to $
u$). Let $\mathrm{spf}$ be a scaled power function equal to $\mathrm{ChoiceScale.spf\_ch}(\dots)$ built from these data. Then $$\|T f\|_{L^q(
u)} \le 2A \cdot q^{q^{-1}} \cdot \Big(\mathbf{1}[q_1 < \infty]\,|q - q_1|^{-1} + \mathbf{1}[q_0 < \infty]\,|q - q_0|^{-1}\Big)^{q^{-1}} \cdot C_0^{1-t}\, C_1^{t}\, \|f\|_{L^p(\mu)}. Here all exponents $p, q, p_0, p_1, q_0, q_1, t$ lie in the extended nonnegative reals $[0,\infty]$, $C_0, C_1, A$ are nonnegative reals, $\mathbf{1}[\cdot]$ is $1$ if the condition holds and $0$ otherwise, real powers use the real numbers $q^{-1}$, $1-t$, $t$ etc. converted from $[0,\infty]$, and $|q-q_i|^{-1}$ is computed in the reals (with $0^{-1}=0$) and then viewed in $[0,\infty]$.

MeasureTheory.combine_estimates₀.statement:
Let $\alpha$ and $\alpha'$ be measurable spaces with measures $\mu$ on $\alpha$ and $
u$ on $\alpha'$, let $E_1$ be a topological space carrying an extended-seminormed additive monoid structure ($\mathrm{ESeminormedAddMonoid}$), and let $E_2$ be a topological space with a continuous extended norm ($\mathrm{ContinuousENorm}$). Let $T$ map functions $\alpha 	o E_1$ to functions $\alpha' 	o E_2$. Let $p,q,p_0,q_0,p_1,q_1,t \in [0,\infty]$, and let $A, C_0, C_1$ be nonnegative reals with $A > 0$, $C_0 > 0$, $C_1 > 0$. Assume $p_0 \in (0, q_0]$, $p_1 \in (0, q_1]$, $t \in (0,1)$, $p_0 < p_1$, $q_0 
e q_1$, $p^{-1} = (1-t)p_0^{-1} + t p_1^{-1}$ and $q^{-1} = (1-t)q_0^{-1} + t q_1^{-1}$. Let $f : \alpha 	o E_1$ with $f \in L^p(\mu)$ and $0 < \|f\|_{L^p(\mu)} < \infty$; suppose $T$ is subadditive under truncation of $f$ with constant $A$ with respect to $
u$ ($\mathrm{SubadditiveTrunc}\ T\ A\ f\ 
u$), let $\mathrm{spf}$ be a scaled power function equal to $\mathrm{ChoiceScale.spf\_ch}(\dots)$ built from these data, and suppose $T$ has weak type $(p_1, q_1)$ with constant $C_1$ and weak type $(p_0, q_0)$ with constant $C_0$ (from $\mu$ to $
u$), and $T$ preserves a.e. strong measurability for $L^p$ functions (from $\mu$ to $
u$). Then $$\int^{-} \|T f(x)\|_e^{q}\, d
u(x) \le (2A)^{q}\, q \cdot \Big(\mathbf{1}[q_1 < \infty]\,|q - q_1|^{-1} + \mathbf{1}[q_0 < \infty]\,|q - q_0|^{-1}\Big) \cdot C_0^{(1-t)q}\, C_1^{tq}\, \|f\|_{L^p(\mu)}^{q},$$ where the left side is the lower Lebesgue integral of the extended norm, $(2A)^q q$ is computed in the reals and then viewed in $[0,\infty]$, and all powers are real powers with $q$ (and $1-t$, $t$) converted to real numbers. Here all exponents $p, q, p_0, p_1, q_0, q_1, t$ lie in the extended nonnegative reals $[0,\infty]$, $C_0, C_1, A$ are nonnegative reals, $\mathbf{1}[\cdot]$ is $1$ if the condition holds and $0$ otherwise, real powers use the real numbers $q^{-1}$, $1-t$, $t$ etc. converted from $[0,\infty]$, and $|q-q_i|^{-1}$ is computed in the reals (with $0^{-1}=0$) and then viewed in $[0,\infty]$.

MeasureTheory.exists_hasStrongType_real_.statement:
Let $\alpha$ and $\alpha'$ be measurable spaces with measures $\mu$ on $\alpha$ and $
u$ on $\alpha'$, let $E_1$ be a topological space carrying an extended-seminormed additive monoid structure ($\mathrm{ESeminormedAddMonoid}$), and let $E_2$ be a topological space with a continuous extended norm ($\mathrm{ContinuousENorm}$). Let $T$ map functions $\alpha 	o E_1$ to functions $\alpha' 	o E_2$. Let $p_0,p_1,q_0,q_1,p,q,t \in [0,\infty]$ and let $A, C_0, C_1$ be nonnegative reals with $A > 0$, $C_0 > 0$, $C_1 > 0$. Assume $p_0 \in (0, q_0]$, $p_1 \in (0, q_1]$, $q_0 
e q_1$, $t \in (0,1)$, $p^{-1} = (1-t)/p_0 + t/p_1$ and $q^{-1} = (1-t)/q_0 + t/q_1$. Let $f : \alpha 	o E_1$, and suppose $T$ is subadditive under truncation of $f$ with constant $A$ with respect to $
u$ ($\mathrm{SubadditiveTrunc}\ T\ A\ f\ 
u$), $T$ has weak type $(p_0, q_0)$ with constant $C_0$ and weak type $(p_1, q_1)$ with constant $C_1$ (from $\mu$ to $
u$), $T$ preserves a.e. strong measurability for $L^p$ functions (from $\mu$ to $
u$), and $f \in L^p(\mu)$. Then $$\|T f\|_{L^q(
u)} \le c \cdot q^{q^{-1}} \cdot \Big(\mathbf{1}[q_1 < \infty]\,|q - q_1|^{-1} + \mathbf{1}[q_0 < \infty]\,|q - q_0|^{-1}\Big)^{q^{-1}} \cdot C_0^{1-t}\, C_1^{t}\, \|f\|_{L^p(\mu)},$$ where $c = 1$ if $p_0 = p_1$ and $c = 2A$ otherwise. Here all exponents $p, q, p_0, p_1, q_0, q_1, t$ lie in the extended nonnegative reals $[0,\infty]$, $C_0, C_1, A$ are nonnegative reals, $\mathbf{1}[\cdot]$ is $1$ if the condition holds and $0$ otherwise, real powers use the real numbers $q^{-1}$, $1-t$, $t$ etc. converted from $[0,\infty]$, and $|q-q_i|^{-1}$ is computed in the reals (with $0^{-1}=0$) and then viewed in $[0,\infty]$. According to the docstring, this is the main estimate for the real interpolation theorem, before taking roots, combining the cases $p_0 
e p_1$ and $p_0 = p_1$.
